Trace, implement and test: 剑指 Offer II 022. 链表中环的入口节点

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
/* class ListNode {
*     var val: Int
*     var next: ListNode?
*     init(_ val: Int) {
*         self.val = val
*         self.next = nil
*     }
* }
*/

class Solution {
    func detectCycle(_ head: ListNode?) -> ListNode? {
        var fast = head
        var slow = head
        
        while fast != nil && fast?.next != nil {
            slow = slow?.next
            fast = fast?.next?.next
            
            if slow === fast {
                var ans = head
                while ans !== slow {
                    ans = ans?.next
                    slow = slow?.next
                }
                return ans
            }
        }
        return nil
    }
}
